__note: Specification of Scenario 02. Not an export. Nothing is connected.
name: S02 Evidence registration
invariants: The received file is created in 01_Original_Evidence and NEVER updated, moved destructively, annotated, resized or deleted (D-13).
A derivative is written to 02_Derived_Images as a separate file with its own record.
The checksum is taken from the storage provider's own file metadata where available, rather than downloading the file (C-03).
A suspected duplicate is FLAGGED, never deleted or merged (S-09).

modules.name: Resolve or create the period folder

config.algorithm: look up by parent and exact name before creating; more than one match is an ERROR, never a choice

errorRoute.action: dead-letter; duplicate folder needs human resolution

config.note: Provider-computed checksum is better evidence than a client-asserted one, and far cheaper than downloading

modules.name: Record original file reference and metadata

config.note: IsOriginalDeviceImageVerified stays FALSE until real-device testing proves no upstream re-encoding

config.rule: same checksum within the same project and period
config.action: set IsDuplicateSuspected and DuplicateOfPhotoID. FLAG ONLY — never delete, never merge
